headline: Leclerc tops Austin FP2 by 0.042s from Antonelli
body: Leclerc set a 1:35.291 on softs, with Antonelli 0.042s back and Verstappen third, just under two tenths off. Hamilton was fourth, more than six tenths behind his team-mate.

headline: Hadjar calls his Red Bull "undriveable" after FP2 set-up changes
body: Hadjar finished FP2 ninth, 0.931s behind Verstappen, with the front tyres overheating through the high-speed corners on the softs. Red Bull technical director Pierre Wache says the set-up direction taken between sessions will be undone for Saturday.

headline: Newey says Honda is disappointed with its 2026 progress
body: Aston Martin team principal Adrian Newey says Honda has been a little disappointed with how much progress it made this year, and points to projects in early development for 2027.

headline: Bearman calls a Ferrari seat his "ultimate goal"
body: Oliver Bearman says he feels he has earned the chance to look for a top-four team. Haas has announced Formula 2 leader Rafael Camara as Esteban Ocon's replacement for 2027, and Bearman is yet to be confirmed for next season.
